description: OPERA Payment Method: what the desk takes money in, how the till counts it and the ERP Mode of Payment it posts to.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: The value stored on records. It can't change once saved; reword the description instead.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: What the desk sees. Blank: the code.

fields.label: Property
fields.description: The property that offers this payment method. Blank for shared rows; a property row overrides the shared row of the same code for that property.

fields.label: Tender Type
fields.options:
Cash
Foreign Cash
Card
Instant
Bank Transfer
OTA Prepaid
Company Credit
Payment Link
Cheque
Other
fields.description: How the till treats it: Cash is counted in the drawer, Card and Instant (mobile money, wallets) keep their own till totals, everything else is Other.

fields.label: ERP Mode of Payment
fields.description: The Accounting Mode of Payment this method posts to. Blank: the ERP bridge's own mapping.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Lower is listed first. 0 lists after the seeded codes.

fields.label: System Code
fields.description: The PMS itself uses this code: it can be reworded but not deleted or switched off.

fields.label: Disabled
fields.description: Switched off: no longer offered. Records that already carry it keep it.

name: Payment Method
